description: A shell script for setting up and initializing a PostgreSQL database, including starting the server if necessary, creating the database and user, applying a SQL schema, and generating connection configuration files.

methods.name: is_pg_ready
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL is ready to accept connections on the specified port by using pg_isready.

methods.name: start_postgres_if_needed
methods.description: Starts PostgreSQL server if it is not already running and ready, initializing data directory if needed.

methods.name: ensure_db_and_user
methods.description: Creates the database and user, and grants privileges.

methods.name: apply_schema
methods.description: Applies the SQL schema for the chess platform from an external file.

methods.name: write_connection_files
methods.description: Generates files with connection details for humans and scripts.

methods.name: print_summary
methods.description: Outputs a summary of the setup process and connection instructions.
